name: tenax
headline: TenaX: Social Media & Email Marketing Automation
short_description: The Munshify TenaX platform is a premiere social media marketing tools, marketing tool, online campaign tool, and email marketing tools for sharing content and automating digital campaigns, enhancing your brand’s visibility and marketing efficiency.
author: munshify

sections.overview:
TenaX is a comprehensive marketing automation platform that combines social media management, email marketing, and campaign orchestration in a unified dashboard. It enables businesses to schedule posts across multiple social channels, automate email campaigns, and segment audiences for targeted outreach. The platform streamlines routine marketing tasks—from content scheduling to performance analytics—freeing teams to focus on strategy. TenaX serves marketing professionals, small businesses, and enterprises seeking to improve engagement, save time, and increase brand visibility through integrated digital campaign management.
Schedule and publish social media posts across multiple platforms
Automate personalized email campaigns with audience segmentation
Manage all social and email channels from a single unified dashboard
Track campaign performance with built-in analytics and reporting
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/munshify/tenax`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a digital marketing expert using the Munshify TenaX platform. Create a 30-day social media content calendar for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business, focusing on [GOAL]. Include a mix of promotional, educational, and engaging content. Prioritize platforms where [TARGET_AUDIENCE] is most active.
```
